title: Introduction and overview — De Zeven Provincien-class Frigate
description: Introduction and overview of the De Zeven Provincien-class Frigate: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Dutch De Zeven Provinciën class — four ships — are air-defense frigates with the APAR and SMART-L radars, famous for tracking ballistic missiles in tests (one tracked a target beyond the atmosphere). With 40 Mk 41 cells, they are among Europe's most capable frigates. Baseline facts: Dutch air-defense frigate; 4 built; APAR/SMART-L; ballistic-missile tracking tests..
